title: Remove cam covers, set TDC and lock the camshafts

notices.text: Photograph the VarioCam Plus solenoid positions and their wiring before removal. 2003 3.6 SPECIFIC: this is a VarioCam Plus engine — variable timing via an electro-hydraulic rotary vane adjuster at the nose of each INTAKE camshaft, plus two-stage valve lift via switchable tappets. It is NOT the earlier 3.4's chain-tensioner-actuated VarioCam. Note also that the 3.6 M96.03 is a THREE-chain engine (crank-to-IMS plus one chain per bank), where the 1999-2001 3.4 is a five-chain engine — the parts and the timing procedure are not interchangeable.

steps.text: Remove cam covers, set TDC and lock the camshafts.
